thag6.6:1.1: Paṇṇavīsativassāni yato pabbajito ahaṃ accharāsaṃghātamattam pi cetosantim anajjhagaṃ. || ||
thag6.6:2.1: aladdhā cittass' ekaggaṃ kāmarāgena addito bāhā paggayha kandanto vihārān upanikkhamiṃ. || ||
thag6.6:3.1: satthaṃ vā āharissāmi, ko attho jīvitena me, kathaṃ hi sikkhaṃ paccakkhaṃ kālaṃ kubbetha mādiso. || ||
thag6.6:4.1: tadāhaṃ khuram ādāya mañcakamhi upāvisiṃ; parinīto khuro āsi dhamaniṃ chettum attano.
